name: Mountaintops
description: Receive and send public BSV payments with your BRC-100 wallet.

groupPermissions.description: Use Mountaintops to recover addresses and payments, save receiving choices, and send BSV.

protocolPermissions.description: Restore the addresses belonging to your wallet account.
Derive your receiving addresses and sign imports of your coins.
Encrypt, sign, verify, and recover your saved addresses, receiving choice, and recovery records.
Find unfinished Mountaintops actions and prevent duplicate payments.
Identify saved address and recovery records.
Identify retained payment evidence for your addresses.

basketAccess.description: Read and save encrypted address and recovery records.
Retain and recover transaction evidence for coins sent to your addresses.

spendingAuthorization.description: Allow up to 100,000 satoshis per month for BSV payments and wallet/network fees. Amounts above the allowance need separate wallet approval.
